title: Not like the one on the photo
text:
Not like the one on the photo. the material is good and not flimsy...but gave it one star because of the false advertisement.

The one in the photo has a nice border that is about 5 inches high. The one I received, although with the same fabric, did not have that nice border, instead it was two round pieces of material sown together...well, I could have done that! False advertising always gets my goat. I would NOT recommend.
